company.name: TPConnects
company.shortDescription: TPConnects is an IT Provider that delivers next-gen travel retailing technology for airlines and travel sellers.
company.description: TPConnects is a Dubai-based travel technology company specializing in airline retailing, NDC distribution, and content aggregation solutions. Founded in 2012, it provides SaaS platforms like Astra for airlines and Iris for travel sellers, helping streamline bookings, distribution, and personalized travel offers. TPConnects is IATA-certified and partners with airlines, travel agencies, and global distribution systems to modernize travel commerce through AI-ready retailing technologies.

productsAndServices.description: A SaaS airline retailing platform for managing offers, orders, NDC distribution, payments, and airline sales channels.
productsAndServices.name: Astra

productsAndServices.description: A travel seller aggregation platform that combines NDC, low-cost carrier, GDS, consolidator, and other air content for shopping, booking, servicing, pricing, and distribution.
productsAndServices.name: Iris

productsAndServices.description: A conversational AI capability for travel planning and booking workflows, using natural-language interaction to manage offers, travel queries, and booking changes.
